use default

bead_sort(values: List[int]) -> List[int] is
    let tallest = values |> reduce(0, (most, value) =>
        if value > most then value else most fi)

    let beads =
        (0..tallest)
        |> map(level => values |> filter(value => value > level) |> count())
        |> collect_list()

    return
        (0..values.count)
        |> map(row => beads |> filter(count => count > row) |> count())
        |> reverse()
        |> collect_list()
